text:
```yaml
name: Lint
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, release/v*]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, release/v*]
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      statuses: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Instrument with OpenTelemetry
        uses: plengauer/opentelemetry-github/actions/instrument/job@v5.45.1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Lint Code Base
        uses: super-linter/super-linter@v8.5.0
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE: true
```
